name: Aged to Perfection
subtitle: 55+ Life Group
about: Like a fine wine, a great steak, or good cheese, our 55-and-over group is aged to perfection. Come join us for a great time of study and fellowship.

name: Becoming A Disciple
subtitle: Growth Group
about: Explore the depths of God's word and how to live out His truth every day — building an intimate relationship with Him and walking in the power of the Holy Spirit. Current study: The Reliability of the Bible — how we know it wasn't changed over time and why we can trust it.

name: Bible Study with The Colemans
subtitle: Weekly Bible Study
about: Come to our home to study the Word of God together. We cover many topics over time, all biblically based. Anyone is welcome — we just don’t have space for children at this time.

name: Christian Worldview & Apologetics
subtitle: Worldview Study
about: Food, fellowship, and most importantly digging into the Word. We study what a Christian worldview is, how it shapes every part of life, and biblical apologetics topics. All ages welcome.

name: Coffee with my Father
subtitle: Sunday Morning Group
about: A weekly Sunday-morning Bible study over coffee, hosted in Bill and Kim’s home.

name: Kingdom Focus
subtitle: Saturday Study
about: Reading Experiencing God by Henry Blackaby — learning to recognize God’s voice, know and do His will, and grow stronger in faith. We discuss the reading, watch the study videos, share fellowship, and pray together. Currently a mix of ladies on different walks — perfect if you’re actively seeking Jesus or feel alone in your faith.

name: Ladies @ The Burg
subtitle: Women's Monthly Group
about: A close-knit community of women from diverse backgrounds gathering for spiritual growth, service, and fellowship — through Bible study, outreach projects, and social events. Ladies of all ages are welcome.

name: Ladies Bible Study Fellowship
subtitle: Women's Weekly Study (BSF)
about: An in-depth, global Bible study with personal study questions, small-group discussion, lecture, and lesson notes. Ladies from all churches welcome. Register at mybsf.org — BSF assigns your discussion group. Sept 2026 – May 2027: Romans.

name: Lunch & Learn Bible Study Group
subtitle: Monthly Fellowship & Study
location: Local restaurant (lunch) · home in N. Charlotte (study)
about: Lunch and fellowship at a local eatery after the 3rd service on the 2nd Sunday of each month; Bible study on the 4th Sunday in a home in North Charlotte (no young children at the study for safety/space). Everyone is welcome at the lunch.

name: Monday Men's Bible Study
subtitle: Men's Weekly Study
about: A Bible study that helps men become the leaders of their homes by digging deeper into the Word and building godly friendships with other men.

name: P.A.L.S.
subtitle: Praying and Loving Sisters
about: Dinner at 6pm, then study and prayer 7–8:15pm, plus a text prayer group to support each other between meetings. Fall 2026 study: Fight Back with Joy by Margaret Feinberg.

name: Prayer and Compassion
subtitle: Prayer Group
about: Join us on Sundays before the service for a time of prayer.

name: The Story of Jesus Bible Study
subtitle: 8-Week Fall Study
about: An 8-week study on the life of Jesus with videos by Randy Frazee. A great way for you (and your spouse, if married) to start Bible study, make deeper friendships, and prepare for Christmas. Childcare can be arranged.

name: Wholehearted — Deeper
subtitle: Healing & Growth Class
about: An intentional journey toward wholeness and healing in relationship with God. We go deeper into hearing God’s voice, inner healing, spiritual warfare, prayer, and identity in Christ — because there is more.

name: Women in the Word
subtitle: Women's Biweekly Study
about: A biweekly group for women in all walks of life to build community and learn about Christ together as we read through the Bible.

name: Women's Bible Study & Fellowship
subtitle: Women's Study Group
about: A group for all ladies. Currently studying Brave and Beloved by Meredith Storrs.

name: Blessed At The Burg
subtitle: Special Needs Ministry
about: Supporting NC Special Olympics and our special needs community — partnering with local teams and blessing families in Harrisburg. You’ll be blessed by these friendships and this outreach.

name: Homeless Outreach at the Mission
subtitle: Outreach · Concord
location: Mission of Hellfighters · 590 Church St N, Concord
about: We partner with the Hellfighters of Concord to feed the homeless at their Mission on the 3rd Sunday of every month after a short devotional. We also provide a meal for their Bible study on the 1st Monday, run an Oct–Dec Christmas drive (socks, hats, gloves, toiletries), and collect gently used clothing year-round.

name: Marriage Ministry
subtitle: Couples Community
about: If you’re married, this is for you. Fellowship, grow, and build community while we discuss topics every marriage faces. Bring a dish to share — childcare is provided!

name: Building a Marriage
subtitle: Young Married Couples
about: Young married couples connecting and growing stronger together — strengthening our relationships with God and with each other.

name: Bumps At The Burg
subtitle: Expecting Moms
about: A community for expecting moms to journey through pregnancy together — friendship, shared stories, and real conversation. No matter your background or where you are on the road to motherhood, you belong here.

name: Burg Hiking
subtitle: Outdoor Adventure
about: Explore breathtaking hikes and enjoy the beauty of God’s creation together. Seasoned hiker or beginner, we take the trails at a pace almost anyone can enjoy.

name: Co-Ed Golf Tribe
subtitle: Golf · All Skill Levels
about: Join us every month at the driving range or out on a course. All skill levels welcome.

name: Dinner Out
subtitle: Monthly Dinner
about: Good food with good people — we try a different local restaurant each month.

name: Evening at the Farm
subtitle: Homestead Skills
about: Learn homestead skills hands-on: canning, herbs as medicine, gardening, chicken care, making jams, and more. No farm needed — it’s about learning to do things yourself, whatever your home looks like.

name: Gears For God
subtitle: Car Enthusiasts
about: Love God and cars? A group for auto enthusiasts: a cars-and-coffee show every 2nd Saturday, plus weeknight meetups to plan excursions.

name: In-Between Sisterhood
subtitle: Women 30–45
about: For women 30–45 who are too old for young adults, too young for the golden gals, and too fabulous to be forgotten. No husbands, no kids, no chaos — just real talk, deep laughs, and fellowship. Yoga pants welcome.

name: Mamas on the Move
subtitle: Moms & Little Ones
location: Frank Liske Park & around Cabarrus Co.
about: A social group for young mamas and their littles — walks, coffee chats, and moms’ nights out. Find community and support as we grow in motherhood and follow Jesus together.

name: Movie Night
subtitle: Monthly Movie
about: A monthly movie and fellowship night — grab your popcorn!

name: Pickleball Group
subtitle: Pickleball · All Levels
about: Hit the courts with fellow Burg members and build friendships one rally at a time.

name: Prime Time
subtitle: Empty Nesters
about: For empty nesters, almost empty nesters, and the young at heart. We gather monthly for fun and fellowship.

name: Sewing/Quilting Group
subtitle: Creative Arts
schedule: Every other Thu evening · Fri & Sat mornings
about: Learn to sew — all skill levels welcome. Projects vary: baby blankets, aprons for moms in Africa, pillows, quilts, even a dress.
